title: Abdominal Wound
summary: Cover an open abdominal wound with a moist, clean dressing. Do not push organs back in. Lie the person down with knees bent and treat for shock.

callEmergency.headline: Call {EMERGENCY} for any open or penetrating abdominal wound
when: Any stab or penetrating wound to the abdomen

steps.title: Position
steps.text: Help them lie on their back with knees bent and supported – this eases tension on the wound.

steps.title: Cover the wound
steps.text: Cover with a large, clean, moist dressing or cling film. If organs are showing, cover them loosely – do not push them back in.

steps.title: Control bleeding
steps.text: Apply gentle pressure around the wound. Do not press directly on exposed organs.

steps.title: Treat for shock and monitor
steps.text: Keep them warm and still and check breathing regularly.

warningSigns: Increasing pain or swelling of the abdomen
doNot: Do not push organs back in
Do not give food or drink
